FAQs

items.a: Paint Protection Film, or PPF, is a virtually invisible, self-healing layer applied to your vehicle’s exterior to protect it from scratches, chips, and other damage, all while maintaining its original appearance.

items.q: How long does the PPF installation process take?
items.a: The duration of the installation depends on the size and type of your vehicle. Typically, it can take a day for a standard car, but our team will provide a more precise estimate upon evaluation.

items.q: Can PPF be applied to any type of vehicle?
items.a: Yes, PPF can be applied to various types of vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, boats, and even planes. Our tailored solutions cater to all vehicle categories.

items.q: Is PPF easy to clean and maintain?
items.a: Yes, PPF is easy to clean and maintain. You can wash your vehicle as usual, and the film’s protective barrier ensures that your car maintains its original shine.

items.q: Will PPF affect the appearance of my car?
items.a: No, PPF is optically clear and doesn’t affect the look of your vehicle. It preserves your car’s original finish while offering protection.

items.q: Can PPF be removed without damaging the paint?
items.a: Absolutely. Unlike many other brands, our 3M Pro film can be removed without leaving any damage to the paint.

items.q: How long does PPF last, and is it backed by a warranty?
items.a: Our 3M Pro PPF comes with a 10-year warranty against cracking, bubbling, and yellowing. It is designed to be long-lasting, offering you peace of mind.

items.q: Does PPF protect against stone chips and minor dents?
items.a: Yes, PPF offers protection against stone chips, most scratches, and even minor dents, keeping your vehicle’s exterior in excellent condition.

items.q: Can PPF heal minor scratches on its own?
items.a: Yes, in warm weather, minor scratches in the top coat of PPF have a self-healing property, maintaining the film’s clarity and appearance.

items.q: How can I schedule an appointment or request a quote?
items.a: You can easily schedule an appointment or request a quote by reaching out to our team through our contact information provided on our website. We’re here to assist you in preserving your vehicle’s beauty and protection.
